reliability.rationale: Four low-dose fluorescence calibrations are explicit; all six concentration targets are held jointly by peptide-dye condition. Persistence MAE38661.13 is nearly tied with Langmuir38656.41. Later local inversion17755.98 was not promoted.

mechanism.rationale: Computational parity validates implementation, not causal mechanism; scientific-critical review is separate.

novelty.rationale: No computational result certifies novelty; disclosed source analyses remain prior art.

significance.rationale: Performance and negative evidence are meaningful only under the stated input/calibration and grouped cohort.

reproducibility.rationale: Independent native reconstruction, every frozen equation, equal-group metric recomputation, target poison, row-order invariance and standalone replay all passed.

impact.rationale: No prospective operational or experimental intervention was performed.

limitations: Only two reserved peptide-dye conditions, correlated dye/peptide factors and arbitrary fluorescence scale. Parameters at bounds do not identify binding affinity.
All outcomes are exposed. This review is computational review by a separate agent, not experimental replication.
